verdict.rationale: Docs advertise "per-token pricing" for 100+ serverless models and community evidence confirms self-serve signup with visible per-token cost (e.g. "$0.0001/1K tokens", $25 trial credit) with no sales contact required. However, no evidence pack item directly shows a public pricing page enumerating rates for every hosted model, and the live models API requires an API key to enumerate the catalog. Missing for 10: a documented public pricing page/table covering all models, independent confirmation that all model prices (not just examples) are visible pre-signup.
